meta_title: Firmware partners · The projects our boards run on
meta_description: OpenDrone ships on Betaflight, AM32 and ExpressLRS. Who they are, how to donate to them directly, and how Incutec supports them.
title: We are nothing without firmware
lead: Every OpenDrone board runs on community firmware we didn't write. We will try to support these projects in any way we can as soon as profits can be shared in that way.
s1_body: Every product page names the firmware its board runs and links both the project and its donation page, so our sales traffic lands on their doorstep, not just ours.
On our side: we pay the regular sums that come with certifying our hardware for their projects, and we make public donations when the numbers allow it.
partner_betaflight_blurb: Betaflight is the flight controller firmware used in most mini-quad freestyle builds.
partner_am32_blurb: AM32 is a multi-MCU ESC firmware alternative to BLHeli, GPL-3.0 licensed. OpenESC runs AM32 on AT32F421 channels: the same firmware as other AM32 ESCs, no custom fork, no vendor lock-in.
partner_expresslrs_blurb: ExpressLRS is the open long-range 2.4 GHz / 900 MHz radio protocol.
s3_body: The most direct support is yours. Where a project runs a public donation page, its card above links to it; giving directly means no payment-processor detour, so what you send reaches them. AM32 runs no donation page: contributing code and testing is the way in there.
s4_body: Money is one half; patches are the other. These are our changes that upstream actually merged: every link goes to the real PR.
